summary: The subversion module checks out a repo to dest or updates it to a revision if it exists; externals aren't handled.
questions: How do I deploy from an SVN repository with Ansible?
Does the subversion module handle svn externals?

answer_card.title: Deploy from Subversion
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.subversion` checks out a repo/revision to `dest`, or updates if it exists. Externals are not handled.
